title: calamintha neorotundifolia
intro: Calamintha neorotundifolia, commonly known as Mountain Melissa, is a plant species in the mint family. It is traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing stress and anxiety, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Calamintha neorotundifolia include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe the nervous system and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
